They may have hit something hard, gotten feedback that landed wrong, or looked around and concluded they are behind where they should be. The bare minimum is armor. The goal is to crack the door open so they can say what is actually going on, then reconnect the work to something that matters to them specifically.", "holdFirm": ["The standard of contribution stays the same regardless of what is going on internally.", "They do not get to disappear into the background on your watch."], "stayFlexible": ["What they work on first to get their footing back.", "Whether they rebuild through a visible win, a quieter project, or a short conversation with you each week."], "forceLevel": {"level": 2, "label": "Questions"}, "script": [{"phase": "Connection", "words": "I noticed you have been pretty heads down lately, and I am not saying that as a complaint. I am asking because the answer changes what we do next."}, {"phase": "Collaboration", "words": "Tell me what part of this role, even a small part, felt like it actually meant something when you first came in. situation: Someone I am responsible for has gone quiet and is doing the bare minimum.
